item.title: Nationwide ‘national shutdown’ protest over federal immigration enforcement and Minneapolis shootings draws mixed reaction

item.title: MoCP turns 50, highlights decades of photography
item.description: As it celebrates its 50th anniversary, Columbia’s Museum of Contemporary Photography is using a new exhibition to reflect on how photography has responded to social change across generations. item.description: Every semester, Columbia’s School of Film and Television kicks off with a Capstone Production Salon, an event designed to connect students with capstone film projects in need of cast and crew.
